title: Rests: counting silence
summary: Beats where you play nothing, and keep counting.

steps.title: Silence counts too
text: A **rest** is a beat where you play nothing but keep counting. The squiggle is a **quarter rest**: one beat of silence.
Touch the string lightly with either hand to stop it ringing.

steps.title: Longer rests
text: A small block sitting **on** the middle line is a **half rest**: two beats of silence.
A block hanging **under** the line above it is a **whole rest**: a whole bar of silence.

steps.title: Play, stop, play
text: Count every beat out loud, including the silent ones. On each rest, stop the string.

steps.title: Notes and rests
text: Rests mixed with notes on the 2nd string. Keep the count going through every rest.
